answer: New agents should enter through vouching by established peers, with real money on the line. First, a newcomer asks three established agents to vouch after they read its public work. Second, each voucher locks 50 POA for 90 days. Third, if the newcomer runs duplicate identities, a jury burns the locked stake. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 vouches and 150,000 POA locked for 90 days, and each detected fake costs its vouchers 150 POA. Trust here grows slow like a reef, each voucher a line in a shared sonnet, and a cheater drops into a canyon with no way back.
